replication.target_description: Classic ISE: bonus assigned to US versus Singapore commenters criticizing the US. Table 5 independent-samples comparison prints requested Cohen d.

n.exclusions: Nine manipulation-check exclusions reported; full analysis N = 1,459. Printed completions and exclusions do not reconcile arithmetically; final Table 5 groups used.
n.location: Table 5, p. 7, Ingroup target (classic ISE), n row; section 4.1 Participant exclusions, canonical text line 232.
n.quote: Ingroup target (classic ISE) Outgroup target (bystander ISE) ... Ingroup Outgroup t df p d 95% CI ... n 337 403 357 362 ... we only excluded nine participants who failed the manipulation checks on the commenter origin and/or comment target (see above), leaving N = 1,459 for analysis.

notes: Only n_r assigned; all other fields are placeholders. Arithmetic: 337 + 403 = 740, using Table 5 final ingroup-source and outgroup-source groups under Ingroup target (classic ISE). Requested d identifies this pairwise comparison (printed d = 0.342, t = 4.667, df = 732.41, p < .001; context only). Distinguish registered four-condition Contrast 1, which reports t(1,455) = -4.503, r = .117 and full-model N = 1,459. The remaining Table 5 groups, 357 and 362, concern the bystander ISE and are not included. Source reports 1,508 completions, nine exclusions and final N = 1,459 without reconciling these counts; no recruitment-based N derived.
